points.title: 缺省兼容
points.evidence: ImageStorageSettings.from_config for omitted / null / '' / slash-or-whitespace inputs (including '/', '//', '\\', fullwidth slashes, tabs) stores key_prefix=''. New keys remain original/{id}.{ext}, thumb/{id}.webp, staging/{id}.{ext}. public_url is {public_base_url}/{rel}. Mock put_original without a prefix wrote https://cdn.example.local/image-embedding/original/{id}.png.

points.title: 正向前缀
points.evidence: key_prefix ImageEmbedding and slash/backslash/fullwidth/whitespace equivalents normalize to ImageEmbedding. Keys are ImageEmbedding/original|{thumb}|staging/{id}.ext. public_url is {base}/ImageEmbedding/original/{id}.ext with no mid-path // and no missing slash between prefix and reserved segment. MockImageStorage and S3ImageStorage (built via S3ImageStorage.__new__ + isolated FakeS3Client, no network, no live YAML change) produced identical keys and URLs. boto3 is importable on this machine (1.43.124) but the live gitignored YAML remains use_boto3: false; a real boto3 client was not pointed at live OSS.

points.title: 规范化报错
points.evidence: from_config / normalize_key_prefix raise ValueError with no silent rewrite for '..', '.' segments, exact-case reserved original/thumb/staging, mid spaces, length > 128, and non-string types (int, float, bool, bytes, list, dict). from_config source does not pass key_prefix through _text(). Original, STAGING, Thumb, and ORIGINAL are accepted (reserved check is exact-case only). Length 128 is accepted.

points.title: URL 不加倍（观察）
points.evidence: When public_base_url already ends with /ImageEmbedding and key_prefix is ImageEmbedding, public_url composes a doubled path .../ImageEmbedding/ImageEmbedding/original/{id}.png. Load-time intercept is specification-pending and is not a required fail. Observed and reported only.

points.title: 旧键兼容
points.evidence: An isolated mock mirror received an unprefixed original+thumb, then a new MockImageStorage was created with key_prefix=ImageEmbedding sharing that mirror. Catalog/list/detail views kept the stored unprefixed URLs and were not replaced by a recomputed prefixed URL. read_by_url_or_key(stored URL) returned the legacy bytes. ReembedImageUseCase.read called only the stored original_url. delete via delete_image._clean_up using stored URLs removed original/{id}.png and thumb/{id}.webp but left a decoy planted at ImageEmbedding/original/{id}.png. This forbids deleting old objects by recomputing the current prefix. Non-knife backend files were grepped: only comment lines in ports.py and storage_upload.py mention key_prefix; list/detail/index/delete/reembed do not recompute keys from the current prefix.

points.title: 新写入
points.evidence: IndexImageUseCase.execute_one against MockImageStorage with key_prefix=ImageEmbedding and FakeMetadata returned and stored {base}/ImageEmbedding/original/{id}.png and {base}/ImageEmbedding/thumb/{id}.webp. After mark_deleted, _clean_up using those stored URLs deleted the prefixed objects from memory and the isolated mirror.

points.title: 重复入库
points.evidence: Same bytes were first indexed with an empty prefix (catalog URL {base}/original/{id}.png). After switching storage to key_prefix=ImageEmbedding, a second execute_one kept the first catalog/response URLs (FakeMetadata / ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING first-row-wins, matching index_image get_by_id after put). New-prefix orphan objects were created and recorded: ImageEmbedding/original/117b65db-6618-04ab-abe1-f7225363e063.png and ImageEmbedding/thumb/117b65db-6618-04ab-abe1-f7225363e063.webp. Cleaning orphans is not a required pass item. Isolated temp mirror was cleaned by TemporaryDirectory.

points.title: 前端
points.evidence: No frontend file in this knife. A scan of frontend sources found no key_prefix or ImageEmbedding/ references. Parallel uncommitted library-filter/preference files were not modified (hashes unchanged). Opening a new prefixed URL was not attempted: the running gitignored YAML keeps use_boto3: false and an example public_base_url (https://cdn.example.local/image-embedding). Fetching that host would not prove object reachability. Signed URLs are out of scope. Live YAML was not changed to enable a prefix or real OSS. Honest SKIP/BLOCKED; success was not claimed.

points.title: 回归
points.evidence: guess_ext_from_bytes_header / content_type rules unchanged (jpeg/png/webp/gif; unknown defaults to jpg). thumb_key has no ext argument and always uses .webp, with or without a prefix. staging_key remains staging/{id}.{ext} (ext lowercased), optionally under the prefix. uuid_from_sha256 is still UUID(sha256[:16]); IndexImageUseCase with a prefixed MockImageStorage returned that same id.
